Pricing page: re-retrieval without updates is free; statistics expected to update every two weeks.
product/analysis: if cached analysis is missing, generation is triggered asynchronously; the request returns failure and is not charged; charges 0.1 credit only when analysis data exists.
credit/balance and credit/logs: free of charge.

monthly_rebate.worked_example: 1.5M calls/month -> 150,000 credits deducted at base price; month-end rebate 65,400 credits (5,400 + 60,000), ~40% discount.

billing.home_page_flow: Purchase API Items: 'Select the target API in pricing and consume 0.1 point for each call.'
billing.failed_requests_general: Only stated for comment/insight (failures/timeouts not charged) and product/analysis (missing analysis -> failure, not charged). General rule for failed/empty requests on other endpoints: undocumented.
billing.repeat_requests_general: Only stated for comment/insight (re-retrieval without updates free). Otherwise undocumented. Response field 'cached' exists in every wrapper but its billing effect is undocumented.
billing.skill_billing: TikTok Data Query Skill: basic query 0.2-0.4 credits, analysis scenario 1-2 credits. E-commerce Data Analysis (kalopilot) skill: per-conversation token-based, ~2-5 points simple, ~10-15 complex; requires buying country data package.

error_codes.documented: undocumented. The spec defines no error responses (only 200) and no code list. Every response wrapper has success (boolean), code (string), message (string), debug (object), cached (boolean).
error_codes.secondary_source_only: The official-linked skill client (github.com/sailtonight/kalodata-skill, api.py) treats: HTTP 200 + code '501' with message starting 'The key ' as an API-key rejection (also used for missing parameters); code '2000' or 'acquire connection timeout' as retryable; code '2016' as parameter error or membership/quota limit; message 'not found' as empty result. NOT from the API docs.
